panels.title: Slurm queue: pending jobs
panels.description: Every pending Slurm job the job pusher sees (slurm-exporter, scontrol), longest-waiting first: why it waits (Resources: no free nodes fit it; Priority: others go first; launch_failed_requeued_held: its start failed, often a Prolog error draining the node, and it is held until released), what it asks for, and its priority (0: held).

targets.expr: max by (job_id, user, job_name, partition, reason) (slurm_job_pending_seconds{job="slurm_jobs", partition=~"$partition"})
max by (job_id, user, job_name, partition, reason) (slurm_job_pending_gpus{job="slurm_jobs", partition=~"$partition"})
max by (job_id, user, job_name, partition, reason) (slurm_job_pending_nodes{job="slurm_jobs", partition=~"$partition"})
max by (job_id, user, job_name, partition, reason) (slurm_job_pending_priority{job="slurm_jobs", partition=~"$partition"})

panels.title: Nodes: health and what runs on them
panels.description: One row per Slurm node, by name (click a header to sort by it, e.g. Status for problems first). Status: DOWN (no ssh answer, or Slurm: down or not responding), NO SSH (up, refuses our key), DRAINED (Slurm won't start jobs on it), NO /TIER1 (shared file system missing: jobs using it fail), else SLURM JOB, MANUAL JOB (GPU work started outside Slurm) or IDLE. Problem: the most telling cause, from the collector (ssh, the node's pre-job health check, mounts; gpu_processes.py) or Slurm's reason. A health-check finding such as dmesg's 'task python blocked for more than 122 seconds' comes from a job running then, not from the one it tripped. Last run job: every job running on it now, SLURM (job · user · name) or MANUAL (a GPU workload started outside Slurm: user · workload); with none, the Slurm job it went down on (requeued on a Prolog error, or failed with NODE_FAIL). Slurm columns from the Slurm job pusher (slurm-exporter).

targets.expr: (max by (instance) (slurm_node_state{job="slurm_jobs", instance=~"$node", instance!~"C2-GB300-02-C(0[5-9]|1[0-9])"}) * 0 + 6 and on (instance) (label_replace(gpu_processes_node_status{job="gpu_processes", status="timeout"}, "instance", "$1", "node", "(.*)") or on (instance) slurm_node_state{job="slurm_jobs", instance=~"$node", instance!~"C2-GB300-02-C(0[5-9]|1[0-9])", state=~"down.*|.*[*]"})) or on (instance) (max by (instance) (slurm_node_state{job="slurm_jobs", instance=~"$node", instance!~"C2-GB300-02-C(0[5-9]|1[0-9])"}) * 0 + 5 and on (instance) label_replace(gpu_processes_node_status{job="gpu_processes", status="ssh_denied"}, "instance", "$1", "node", "(.*)")) or on (instance) (max by (instance) (slurm_node_state{job="slurm_jobs", instance=~"$node", instance!~"C2-GB300-02-C(0[5-9]|1[0-9])"}) * 0 + 4 and on (instance) slurm_node_state{job="slurm_jobs", instance=~"$node", instance!~"C2-GB300-02-C(0[5-9]|1[0-9])", state=~".*drain.*"}) or on (instance) (max by (instance) (slurm_node_state{job="slurm_jobs", instance=~"$node", instance!~"C2-GB300-02-C(0[5-9]|1[0-9])"}) * 0 + 3 and on (instance) label_replace(node_mount_ok{job="gpu_processes", node=~"$node", node!~"C2-GB300-02-C(0[5-9]|1[0-9])"}, "instance", "$1", "node", "(.*)") == 0) or on (instance) (max by (instance) (slurm_node_state{job="slurm_jobs", instance=~"$node", instance!~"C2-GB300-02-C(0[5-9]|1[0-9])"}) * 0 + 2 and on (instance) slurm_job_cpu{job="slurm_jobs", instance=~"$node", instance!~"C2-GB300-02-C(0[5-9]|1[0-9])"}) or on (instance) (max by (instance) (slurm_node_state{job="slurm_jobs", instance=~"$node", instance!~"C2-GB300-02-C(0[5-9]|1[0-9])"}) * 0 + 1 and on (instance) label_replace(gpu_process_memory_bytes{job="gpu_processes", slurm_job=""}, "instance", "$1", "node", "(.*)")) or on (instance) (max by (instance) (slurm_node_state{job="slurm_jobs", instance=~"$node", instance!~"C2-GB300-02-C(0[5-9]|1[0-9])"}) * 0)

max by (instance, slurm) (label_replace(label_join(slurm_node_state{job="slurm_jobs", instance=~"$node", instance!~"C2-GB300-02-C(0[5-9]|1[0-9])"}, "slurm", " · ", "state", "reason"), "slurm", "$1", "slurm", "(.*) · $"))
max by (instance) (slurm_node_reason_seconds{job="slurm_jobs", instance=~"$node", instance!~"C2-GB300-02-C(0[5-9]|1[0-9])"}) * 1000

max by (instance, problem) ((label_replace(label_replace(gpu_processes_node_status{job="gpu_processes", status="timeout"}, "instance", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "problem", "no answer over ssh", "", "") or on (instance) label_replace(label_replace(gpu_processes_node_status{job="gpu_processes", status="ssh_denied"}, "instance", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "problem", "ssh refused: Permission denied (publickey)", "", "") or on (instance) label_replace(label_join(label_replace(node_health_check_failure_seconds{job="gpu_processes", node=~"$node", node!~"C2-GB300-02-C(0[5-9]|1[0-9])"}, "instance", "$1", "node", "(.*)") and on (instance) slurm_node_state{job="slurm_jobs", instance=~"$node", instance!~"C2-GB300-02-C(0[5-9]|1[0-9])", state=~".*drain.*"}, "problem", ": ", "check", "detail"), "problem", "$1: $2 blocked > $3 s (at $4)", "problem", "(\\w+): task (\\S+) blocked for more than (\\d+) seconds\\. \\(at (.*):\\d+\\)") or on (instance) label_replace(slurm_node_state{job="slurm_jobs", instance=~"$node", instance!~"C2-GB300-02-C(0[5-9]|1[0-9])", state=~"down.*|.*[*]"} or on (instance) slurm_node_state{job="slurm_jobs", instance=~"$node", instance!~"C2-GB300-02-C(0[5-9]|1[0-9])", state=~".*drain.*"}, "problem", "Slurm: $1", "reason", "(.+)") or on (instance) label_replace(label_replace(node_mount_ok{job="gpu_processes", node=~"$node", node!~"C2-GB300-02-C(0[5-9]|1[0-9])"}, "instance", "$1", "node", "(.*)") == 0, "problem", "/tier1 not mounted", "", "")) and on (instance) max by (instance) (slurm_node_state{job="slurm_jobs", instance=~"$node", instance!~"C2-GB300-02-C(0[5-9]|1[0-9])"}))

(max by (instance, lastjob) (label_replace(label_join(max by (instance, job_id, user, job_name) (slurm_job_cpu{job="slurm_jobs", instance=~"$node", instance!~"C2-GB300-02-C(0[5-9]|1[0-9])"}), "lastjob", " · ", "job_id", "user", "job_name"), "lastjob", "SLURM $1", "lastjob", "(.*)")) or max by (instance, lastjob) (label_replace(label_join(max by (instance, user, workload) (label_replace(gpu_process_memory_bytes{job="gpu_processes", slurm_job=""}, "instance", "$1", "node", "(.*)")), "lastjob", " · ", "user", "workload"), "lastjob", "MANUAL $1", "lastjob", "(.*)"))) or on (instance) max by (instance, lastjob) (label_replace(label_join(slurm_node_cause_job_seconds{job="slurm_jobs", instance=~"$node", instance!~"C2-GB300-02-C(0[5-9]|1[0-9])"}, "lastjob", " · ", "cause_job", "cause_user", "cause_name"), "lastjob", "SLURM $1", "lastjob", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Who is on each GPU
panels.description: The user and workload (container, Slurm job's script, or command) holding the most memory on each GPU; on nodes the collector can't reach, the Slurm job holding it (user and job name), else 'not visible'; free: no process and no Slurm job.

targets.expr: label_replace((max_over_time(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node", instance!~"C2-GB300-02-C(0[5-9]|1[0-9])"}[1d])) and on (instance) label_replace(gpu_processes_node_status{job="gpu_processes", status="timeout"}, "instance", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "who", "not visible", "", "") or on (instance, gpu) label_replace((max_over_time(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node", instance!~"C2-GB300-02-C(0[5-9]|1[0-9])"}[1d])) and on (instance) label_replace(gpu_processes_node_status{job="gpu_processes", status="ssh_denied"}, "instance", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "who", "not visible", "", "") or on (instance, gpu) (topk by (instance, gpu) (1, label_join((label_replace(gpu_process_memory_bytes{job="gpu_processes"}, "instance", "$1", "node", "(.*)") and on (instance, gpu) DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node"}), "who", " · ", "user", "workload")) or on (instance, gpu) label_join((slurm_job_gpu{job="slurm_jobs"} and on (instance, gpu) DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node"}), "who", " · ", "user", "job_name") or on (instance, gpu) label_replace(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node"} unless on (instance) label_replace(gpu_processes_node_up{job="gpu_processes"} == 1, "instance", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "who", "not visible", "", "") or on (instance, gpu) label_replace(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node"}, "who", "free", "", "")) and on (instance, gpu) DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node", instance!~"C2-GB300-02-C(0[5-9]|1[0-9])"}

panels.title: Workloads on GPUs
panels.description: Every process group holding GPU memory, Slurm or not (gpu_processes.py): workload is its Docker container, else its script or command. Only the ones running now: GPUs, Nodes, GPU util and memory now; GPU-hours adds up the GPUs it held each minute over the dashboard's time range, and GPU equivalent is that as GPUs held for the whole range (2 GPUs for half of it: 1.0).

targets.expr: count by (user, workload, slurm_job) (count by (instance, gpu, user, workload, slurm_job) ((label_replace(gpu_process_count{job="gpu_processes"}, "instance", "$1", "node", "(.*)") and on (instance, gpu) DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node"})))

count by (user, workload, slurm_job) (count by (instance, user, workload, slurm_job) ((label_replace(gpu_process_count{job="gpu_processes"}, "instance", "$1", "node", "(.*)") and on (instance, gpu) DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node"})))
